title: Baggage, Postal Articles and Passenger Regulations

content.overview: Passenger baggage is cleared under the baggage rules, with a duty-free allowance and a simplified bill of entry where the rules apply. Goods in commercial quantity are not converted into baggage by being carried. Postal articles follow the postal import route. The concession is an allowance, not an exemption from declaration.
content.glance: Baggage, Postal Articles and Passenger Regulations. Complete Tax treatise with statutory deconstruction, examples, verified authorities, forum analysis and chamber drafting.
content.study: Ask whether the goods are bona fide baggage and within the allowance. If not, use the ordinary import route.

enhancement.definition: Passenger baggage is cleared under the baggage rules, with a duty-free allowance and a simplified bill of entry where the rules apply. Goods in commercial quantity are not converted into baggage by being carried. Postal articles follow the postal import route.
enhancement.legalPrinciple: The concession is an allowance, not an exemption from declaration.
enhancement.statutoryFramework: Customs Act, 1962, baggage provisions; Baggage Rules.
enhancement.detailedExplanation: The rules distinguish used personal effects, a duty-free allowance, and dutiable goods. A passenger must declare dutiable goods. Gold, alcohol and similar items have specific limits in the rules. A trader's consignment carried by hand is assessed as cargo if it is not bona fide baggage. Postal imports are assessed on the postal declaration.
examples: A returning passenger carries personal effects within the allowance.
The same passenger carries goods for sale in commercial quantity.
The allowance does not cover that quantity.
enhancement.problemApplication: Ask whether the goods are bona fide baggage and within the allowance. If not, use the ordinary import route.
enhancement.caseLawNotes: No new case citation or ratio was added. Rates and notifications are not frozen in this note.
enhancement.shortAnswerStructure: Baggage concessions apply to bona fide passenger baggage within the rules. Commercial quantities remain ordinary imports.
